title: Nikita Porwal Carries India's Hopes Into Miss World 2026 Finale Tonight
excerpt: The Ujjain native competes for India's seventh Miss World crown at the 73rd edition in Nha Trang, Vietnam, airing live on JioHotstar at 5:30 PM IST.
body:
• Nikita Porwal represents India at the 73rd Miss World finale in Nha Trang, Vietnam, on September 5 at 5:30 PM IST
  • The Ujjain native performed a Goddess Meenakshi-inspired piece in the Dances of the World segment, wearing a custom Torani creation
  • India has won Miss World six times, with the last crown going to Manushi Chhillar in 2017
  • Porwal's Beauty With A Purpose project delivered 100 water filters and 500 milk powder packets to tribal families

Femina Miss India World 2024 Nikita Porwal takes the stage at the 73rd Miss World Festival Finale in Nha Trang, Vietnam, on September 5, competing against representatives from over 130 countries for the coveted blue crown.

Porwal, 22, from Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, became the first Miss India World from her state when she won the title in October 2024. An actor and theatre artist who has performed in more than 60 stage productions, she authored a 350-page play titled Krishna Leela before entering the pageant circuit.

Dances of the World

Porwal turned heads during the Dances of the World segment with a performance inspired by Goddess Meenakshi, drawing on Indian mythology and classical dance traditions. She wore a custom outfit by designer Karan Torani — a dhoti-style silhouette featuring hand-tapka work and kaleidoscopic details that merged traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary design.

The look was completed with a bespoke gold sculpted bustier and jewellery by Amama Jewels. According to Femina, the ensemble "brought together mythology, craftsmanship and contemporary design, creating a memorable tribute to India's heritage."

Beauty With A Purpose

Porwal's social impact initiative, MAATI — Empowering the Keepers of Our Roots, targets tribal women and children through education and essential resources. The project has distributed 100 water filters and 500 milk powder packets to over 100 tribal families, focusing on clean water access and improved nutrition.

"It means stepping onto that stage carrying her nation's name rather than her own — a sentiment that resonates deeply with the spirit of national pride."

— Underwater Sports Association of India, tribute to Porwal

India's Miss World Legacy

India holds six Miss World crowns — the most by any country alongside Venezuela. Reita Faria won India's first title in 1966, followed by Aishwarya Rai (1994), Diana Hayden (1997), Yukta Mookhey (1999), Priyanka Chopra (2000), and Manushi Chhillar (2017). A seventh crown would extend India's record-tying run and mark the country's first win in nearly a decade.

Beyond the pageant, Porwal has been building a career across entertainment and public speaking, delivering TED Talks at IIM Lucknow and AUMP, representing Gujarat Tourism, and appearing at the 70th Filmfare Awards. She is also reportedly planning her Kannada film debut.

How to Watch

The 73rd Miss World Festival Finale takes place on September 5 at 5:30 PM IST (7:00 PM Vietnam time) at April 2nd Square in Nha Trang. Indian viewers can watch the finale live on JioHotstar. For the Indian diaspora worldwide, the event streams on watchmissworld.com and Fawesome TV.
